scope: Format justification and proposed AST-delta audit only. Candidate implementation not yet received or audited; actual flag result unknown and not inspected.

proposed_change.allowed_delta: Permit only ZIP general-purpose bits1/2 in addition to existing bit11 for method8; method0 remains bit11 only. All remaining original predicates/order and legacy XML validators unchanged.

standard_justification.reason: For Deflate method8, bits1/2 declare Normal/Maximum/Fast/SuperFast compression options. They do not declare encryption or data descriptors and do not justify changed local CRC/sizes/offsets or unsupported method9/14.
standard_justification.boundaries: Descriptors bit3, encryption/masking bits0/6/13, patched/reserved/unused bits remain rejected. Local/central exact flag equality must still hold.

ast_audit_requirements: Parse the exact frozen original _zip_structure and candidate function. Deep-copy the original AST, optionally rename only function identifier, replace exactly one original bit-mask expression with the declared method-dependent expression, and compare full ast.dump excluding location attributes.

Any required custody-qualified identifier normalization must be explicit and finite; do not ignore arbitrary call/attribute differences. Independently verify each referenced helper/constant binding resolves to unchanged legacy code or the exact declared immutable value.

Also inspect the call pipeline: it must invoke the new complete structural traversal followed by unchanged admitted envelope XML validators, with no monkeypatch of old globals and no alternate fallback reader.
receipt_gate_requirements: No execution authority derives from this design. Production must require its own committed source, exact-source CI externally verified by root, unchanged legacy/header/flag sources, original capture/object identity and fixed input/output routes.

Require a closed genuine-production flag receipt with exact producer/profile/source identities, BLOCKED_SCHEMA, MEMBER_FLAGS predecessor, DEFLATE_OPTION_FLAGS_ONLY reason, matching verified object and original capture bridge, expected honest exposures, no scientific claims or extra fields; reject synthetic, stale, mismatched or contradictory receipts.

First failing member category does not imply all members are compatible: every remaining original structural predicate and full new-profile traversal still must pass before envelope work. No actual bit category has been assumed here.

A later XML rejection may occur after decompression/UTF8 decoding. Preserve started/completed component exposure separately; absence of completed components does not imply no decoding attempt or no machine-byte access.
Compatible envelope validity is not workbook/schema/data readiness, endpoint pairing, physical truth, independent sampling or authorization to read worksheet/sharedStrings outcomes.
